summary: Iteration 3 (frontend visual redesign) verified end-to-end. All 9 routes render without JS errors or broken images. Hero badge shows 'Au service des personnes vulnérables' (FR default) and toggles to 'Serving vulnerable people' in EN. No 'OBNL' or 'Organisme à but non lucratif' text anywhere on the site (grep + runtime page-text scan across all 9 pages returned 0 matches). Hero background image visible (nurse/caregiver photo covers full viewport). Contact form POST /api/contact returns success toast. Careers form POST /api/careers multipart with PDF returns success toast. Donations POST /api/donations/checkout returns a checkout.stripe.com URL (verified by intercepted navigation to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...). Regions page still shows all 4 Wikipedia city photos (Montréal, Gatineau, Trois-Rivières, Ottawa) — each img.naturalWidth=960 confirming load. Cookie consent banner (Law 25) still appears. Mobile viewport (390x844) shows org name 'Groupe Havre d'Amour et de Paix' + tagline + FR/EN toggle + working hamburger menu button.
critical_code_review_comments: media.js: hero + section images are hot-linked from images.unsplash.com. Unsplash may rate-limit or change these paths; consider caching them via a CDN or emergentagent assets bucket for production resilience.

Page-count of is 0 on /a-propos and /admin — sections rely on CSS backgroundImage. That matches the design intent (visible backgrounds), but naturalWidth check cannot verify these. Consider adding data-testid+role='img' wrappers with aria-label for a11y and testability.

Home hero card sub-text 'Sécurité & accompagnement permanents' — carried over from iter2 review, still hardcoded in FR (not passing through t()). Low priority since screenshot in EN showed the badge & main copy translate correctly; the small overlay card still needs wiring.
